titulo: What if vampires still had to pay compound interest and taxes on everything from the 1400s?
descripcion:
What if vampires had to pay taxes and compound interest since the 1400s? 🧛💸 A 600-year-old vampire gets audited by the IRS and ends up working the night shift at a convenience store. A funny what-if animation about debt, taxes and immortality.

#shorts #vampire #whatif #compoundinterest #funnyanimation
